reading.title: Fiscal and Policy Note CR-028-2025 PILOT New Carrolton – Affordable – Phase 1 Project

candidates.quote: Revenue: $7,157,432 in tax revenue to be forgone over a 40-year period.
candidates.wording: tax revenue to be forgone over a 40-year period

candidates.quote: Description: A one hundred twelve (112) unit affordable senior rental apartment community that will be constructed in New Carrollton, Maryland.
candidates.wording: one hundred twelve (112) unit affordable senior rental apartment community

candidates.quote: All units will be affordable, and rents will be restricted for forty (40) years.
All units will be affordable, and rents will be restricted for forty (40) years.

The New Carrollton – Affordable - Phase 1 project (the “Project”) is to be located at 4051 Garden City Drive, Hyattsville, Maryland 20785, and is a 112- unit transit-oriented senior affordable housing development.

Under the proposed agreement, for at least a 40- year term, Urban Atlantic Development LLC (the “Developer”) will construct one hundred twelve (112) units for seniors whose incomes are at or below seventy percent (70% ) of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).
candidates.wording: for at least a 40- year term

candidates.quote: Under the proposed agreement, for at least a 40- year term, Urban Atlantic Development LLC (the “Developer”) will construct one hundred twelve (112) units for seniors whose incomes are at or below seventy percent (70% ) of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).

candidates.quote: The project will receive approximately $9,657,432 or 27% of its total funding from the County, as demonstrated below.
The terms of the PILOT agreement include 100% tax waivers of 112 units for the next 40 years, with a 2% annual escalation per unit over that period.
The terms of the PILOT agreement include 100% tax waivers of 112 units for the next 40 years, with a 2% annual escalation per unit over that period.
The PILOT reduces the aggregate tax burden on the entire 112-unit Project by 71.34% of that amount, or approximately $47,600, equivalent to a $425 per unit tax burden on the 112 affordable units.
candidates.wording: reduces the aggregate tax burden on the entire 112-unit Project by 71.34%

candidates.quote: Under the agreement, the County would forgo real property tax revenue of approximately $118,497, or approximately $1,058 per affordable unit, in year one4.
candidates.wording: forgo real property tax revenue of approximately $118,497

candidates.quote: Based on the Washington- Arlington-Alexandria-DC-VA-MD-WV Metro Area regional guidelines, this project includes 112 affordable housing units at 70% or less than AMI.
Based on the Washington- Arlington-Alexandria-DC-VA-MD-WV Metro Area regional guidelines, this project includes 112 affordable housing units at 70% or less than AMI.

Factoring in the 2% estimated average annual increase in the property tax assessment, the total impact is estimated at $ 7,157,432, forgoing 71.34% of the tax revenue cumulatively over the 40-year period that the PILOT agreement remains in effect.
